description: 2-D channel 0<y<H, bottom plate oscillates at U cos(omega t), top plate at rest, periodic in x
reference: Landau & Lifshitz, Fluid Mechanics, §24 (oscillating plate); finite-gap image form W = U[exp(-ky) - exp(-k(2H-y))]/[1-exp(-2kH)] exp(i omega t), k=(1+i)/delta, delta=sqrt(2 nu/omega). Secondary: Macia et al. (2011) Prog. Theor. Phys. 125:1091, doi:10.1143/ptp.125.1091 (SPH for this case).
reference_form: u = Re{ U [exp(-ky)-exp(-k(2H-y))]/[1-exp(-2kH)] e^{i omega t} }, k=(1+i)/delta, delta=sqrt(2 nu/omega)
